Good morning evening crew,
The care lead noted some notes on noise levels later this week, and I wanted to pass it on

Please treat this as a reminder for the Companion Animal Travel Desk while we keep the current flow of passenger requests moving through Aurelia Skyways. There have been more check-ins about cabin comfort, carrier placement, and support for nervous animals, so the desk ledger needs to stay current and clear after each handoff. If you take a call or receive a handoff from the gate team, record the service change right away and keep the note brief, exact, and easy for the next person to read.

The main point is that we may see a few louder conditions near the desk area and at the customer counter, which could affect pets that are already unsettled. Please speak in a lower register when you can, keep crates and carriers steady, and give extra care to families traveling with animals that are sensitive to movement or sound. If a traveler appears unsure, pause long enough to explain the process in plain language and confirm the animal's comfort before moving on. For any case that feels less settled than usual, bring it to the senior coordinator without delay so the record is complete and support can be arranged.

We also need to keep the routine entries neat for the shift handover. If Yuki Wong or Julian Patel appears on a manifest, make sure the animal details and service notes match what was already entered, and flag anything that does not line up. If Cookie or any other pet is listed for added assistance, note the request exactly as received and avoid leaving gaps in the file. This desk works best when every step is logged promptly, because each journey is a shared responsibility and small misses can create extra work for the next crew. Please stay alert, keep the pace steady, and bring any unusual noise issue to the records side at once.
